Linguistic categories.question: GOLD was maintained by the LINGUIST List and others from _____ to 2010
Linguistic categories.fact: GOLD was maintained by the LINGUIST List and others from 2007 to 2010.

Linguistic categories.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Linguistic categories.question: The RELISH project created a mirror of the _____ edition of GOLD as a Data Category Selection within ISOcat
Linguistic categories.fact: GOLD was maintained by the LINGUIST List and others from 2007 to 2010. The RELISH project created a mirror of the 2010 edition of GOLD as a Data Category Selection within ISOcat.

Linguistic categories.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Linguistic categories.question: Accordingly, IS_____ is no longer actively developed
Linguistic categories.fact: Accordingly, ISOcat is no longer actively developed.

Linguistic categories.fact: As of May 2020, successor systems CLARIN Concept Registry and DatCatInfo were emerging. Unlike ISOcat, however, lexinfo is actively maintained and currently (May 2020) extended in a community effor.
